title: Ingestion frame diagnosis
description: A bounded opinion about why a capture's vertical axis could not be resolved deterministically. It carries no transform, no axis the deterministic layer did not already find plausible, and no measurement. It is evidence for a human, never an instruction to the pipeline.

assessment.description: A short label for what the evidence looks like.

reason.description: Why, in terms of the supplied evidence only.

recommendation.description: A closed set. Every value routes through the deterministic rule; none applies a transform.

recommendedAxis.description: Optional, and only ever one of the candidates the deterministic layer already scored as physically plausible. Ignored otherwise.
